summary: Every 4-connected zero component that touches the top or bottom edge is mirrored vertically to the opposite side; every hole touching the left or right edge is mirrored horizontally. The hole's full column band (top/bottom holes) or row band (left/right holes) is then painted 7, with mirrored hole cells taking precedence as 0. Floating holes are skipped by the mirror but may be consumed by other sweeps.
